title: 第7章 调虎离山
content_zh:
崔莹见钱坤等扶着杨武出来，回了房间，心想：“点穴功夫真厉害，这又秃又矮的武师给人点中穴道后一点法子都没有。老师明明也会，可是偏偏不肯教我，看来她还留着许多好功夫，怎么变个法子让她教教我。”回到房里，托着腮帮子出了半天神。吃了饭，陪着母亲说闲话，李梅唠唠叨叨地怪她路上尽闹事。崔莹笑着扮了个鬼脸。

    崔莹正要解衣就寝，忽听院子中一响，窗格子上有人用手指轻弹了几下，一个清脆的声音说：“小朋友，你出来。有话问你。”崔莹一愣，提剑开门，纵进院子，只见一个人影站在那里，说道：“小朋友，有胆的跟我来。”说着便翻出了墙。崔莹是初生牛犊，也不管外面是否有人埋伏，跟着跳出墙外，双脚刚下地，迎面就是一剑刺来。

    崔莹举剑挡开，喝问：“什么人？”那人退了两步说：“我是谷惠允。喂，我问你，咱们河水不犯井水，干嘛你硬给万澜物流集团撑腰，坏我们大事？”崔莹见她俏生生站着，剑尖拄地，左手戟指而问，正是白天跟自己恶斗过的粉衣女郎。崔莹给她这么一问，哑口无言，自己凭空插手，确没什么道理。只好强词夺理：“天下事天下人管得，我就爱管事闹事。不服气么？我再来领教领教你的剑术……”话未说完，唰的就是一剑。谷惠允更加恼怒，举剑相迎。

    崔莹明知剑法上斗不过她，心中已有了主意，边打边退，看准方位，一直退到杜静芳那间房，突然叫道：“老师，人家要杀我呀！”谷惠允嗤的一笑，说道：“哼，没用的东西，才犯不着杀你呢！我是来教训教训你，没本事就少管闲事。”说完掉头就走。哪知崔莹可不让她走了，一招“春云乍展”，挺剑刺她背心。谷惠允回头施展三分剑术，崔莹顿时又被逼得手忙脚乱。她听到身后有人，知道老师已经出来，见谷惠允长剑当胸刺来，一纵就躲到了杜静芳背后。

    杜静芳举起秋水剑挡住谷惠允的剑招。谷惠允见崔莹来了帮手，也不答话，剑招如风，连续十余下进手招数。交手数合，便发觉对手剑招手法和崔莹全然相同，可是自己却丝毫讨不到便宜。她剑招越快，对方越慢，再斗数合，她攻势已尽被抑制，完全处在下风。

    崔莹全神贯注，在旁看两人斗剑，她存心把杜静芳引出来，想偷学一两招老师不肯教的精妙招数，然而见老师所使云水剑法与传给自己的全无二致，但一招一式之中显是蕴藏着极大内劲。

    谷惠允的三分剑术要旨在以快打慢，以变扰敌，但杜静芳并不跟着她迅速的剑法应招变式，数合之后，主客之势即已倒置。谷惠允迭遇险招，知道对方是前辈高手，心下怯了，连使“大漠孤烟”、“平沙落雁”两招，凌厉进攻，待对方举剑挡格，转身欲退。哪知对方剑招连绵不断，粘上了就休想离开。谷惠允暗暗叫苦，只好打起精神厮拼。

    这时崔莹看出了便宜，还剑入鞘，施展团花手加入战团。谷惠允连杜静芳一人都已敌不过，哪禁得崔莹又来助战？崔莹狡猾异常，东摸一把，西勾一腿，并不攻击对方要害，却是存心开玩笑，以报前日马鬣被拉之仇。谷惠允向来端严，哪容得崔莹如此轻薄胡闹，心头气急，门户封得不紧，被杜静芳剑进中宫，点到面门。谷惠允举剑挡开。崔莹乘机蹿到她背后，喝声：“看拳！”一记“猛鸡夺粟”，向她左肩打去。谷惠允左腕翻转，以擒拿法化开。崔莹乘她右手挡剑、左手架拳之际，一掌向她胸口按去，这一掌如打实了，非受重伤不可。谷惠允一惊，双手抽不出来招架，只得向后一仰，以消减对方掌力。

    哪知崔莹并不用劲，一掌触到谷惠允胸部，重重摸了一把，嘻嘻一笑，向后跃开。谷惠允急怒攻心，转身挺剑疾刺。崔莹一避，她又是一剑，竟是存心拼命，对杜静芳的剑不架不闪，尽向崔莹进攻。

    杜静芳日间见到谷惠允剑法精奇，早留了神，原只想考较考较，决无伤她之意，见她对自己剑招竟不理会，待刺到她身边时便凝招不发。这时谷惠允攻势凌厉，崔莹缓不开手拔剑，被迫得连连倒退，口中还在气她：“我摸过啦，我摸过啦！你杀了我也没用的。嘿嘿。”谷惠允一招“神驼骏足”挺剑直刺，剑尖将到之际，突然圈转，使出凌霄阁剑法的独得之秘“海市蜃楼”，虚虚实实，剑光霍霍，崔莹眼花缭乱，手足无措，眼见就要命丧剑下。

    杜静芳这时不能不管，挺剑又把谷惠允的攻势接了过来。
content_en:
Seeing Qian Kun and others helping Yang Wu out, Cui Ying returned to the room and thought: "The acupuncture skills are really good. This bald and short martial artist can't do anything after tapping the acupoints. The teacher obviously knows it, but he refuses to teach me. It seems that she still has a lot of good skills. How can she teach me another way." When she returned to the room, she held her cheek and was thinking for a long time. After dinner, I chatted with my mother. Li Mei naggingly blamed her for causing trouble on the road. Cui Ying smiled and made a face.

    Cui Ying was about to undress and go to bed when she suddenly heard a sound in the yard. Someone flicked their fingers on the window pane a few times, and a clear voice said: "Kid, come out. I have something to ask you." Cui Ying was stunned, opened the door with her sword, and entered the yard. She saw a figure standing there, saying: "Kids, follow me if you are brave." After that, she climbed out of the wall. Cui Ying was a newborn calf, so she jumped out of the wall regardless of whether there was an ambush outside. As soon as her feet hit the ground, she was stabbed by a sword.

    Cui Ying raised her sword to block it and asked: "Who is it?" The man took two steps back and said, "I am Gu Huiyun. Hey, let me ask you, our river water does not violate the well water, why do you insist on supporting Wanlan Logistics Group and ruining our affairs?" Cui Ying saw her standing handsomely, with the tip of her sword on the ground, and her left hand pointed at her. She was the girl in pink who had fought fiercely with her during the day. Cui Ying was speechless when she asked her this question. It really didn't make sense for her to intervene out of thin air. He had no choice but to make excuses: "Everyone in the world can take care of things, but I just like to take care of things and cause trouble. Are you not convinced? I will come again to learn your swordsmanship..." Before he could finish his words, there was a sharp sword strike. Gu Huiyun became even more angry and raised his sword to greet him.

    Cui Ying knew clearly that she couldn't beat her with swordsmanship, so she had an idea in her mind. She fought and retreated, looking for the right direction, until she retreated to Du Jingfang's room. She suddenly shouted: "Teacher, they are going to kill me!" Gu Huiyun sneered and said, "Humph, I'm useless, so I won't kill you! I'm here to teach you a lesson. If you don't have the ability, just mind your own business." After that, he turned around and left. Unexpectedly, Cui Ying wouldn't let her go, so she stabbed her in the back with her sword. Gu Huiyun turned around and used the three-point sword technique, and Cui Ying was immediately forced to scramble again. She heard someone behind her and knew that the teacher had come out. When she saw Gu Huiyun stabbing her chest with her long sword, she hid behind Du Jingfang.

    Du Jingfang raised her Qiushui sword to block Gu Huiyun's sword move. When Gu Huiyun saw Cui Ying coming to help, she didn't answer. She moved her sword like the wind and made more than ten consecutive moves. After a few fights, he discovered that his opponent's sword moves were exactly the same as Cui Ying's, but he couldn't get any advantage at all. The faster she moves with her sword, the slower her opponent becomes. After a few more fights, her offensive has been completely suppressed and she is completely at a disadvantage.

    Cui Ying was engrossed in watching the sword fight between the two. She deliberately lured Du Jingfang out, hoping to secretly learn one or two exquisite moves that the teacher refused to teach. However, she saw that the Yunshui sword technique used by the teacher was exactly the same as the one taught to her, but each move clearly contained great inner strength.

    The key point of Gu Huiyun's three-point swordsmanship is to attack the slow and fast to disturb the enemy, but Du Jingfang did not follow her rapid swordsmanship changes. After a few seconds, the host and guest situation was reversed. Gu Huiyun was in danger of making repeated moves. Knowing that the opponent was a senior master, he felt timid. He used the "Smoke in the Desert" and "Goose Falling on the Sand" moves, attacking fiercely. When the opponent raised his sword to block, he turned around and wanted to retreat. Unexpectedly, the opponent's sword moves are continuous, and once you get stuck, you can't even think about leaving. Gu Huiyun secretly complained and had no choice but to work hard.

    At this time, Cui Ying saw the advantage, returned the sword to its sheath, and used her skills to join the battle group. Gu Huiyun couldn't even defeat Du Jingfang, so how could Cui Ying come to help? Cui Ying was extremely cunning. She touched her in the east and hooked her in the west. She did not attack the opponent's vital points, but was deliberately joking to avenge the horse hyena being pulled the day before. Gu Huiyun had always been strict, but he could not tolerate Cui Ying being so frivolous and mischievous. She was so angry that the door was not sealed tightly, so she was entered into the middle palace by Du Jingfang's sword and hit the front door. Gu Huiyun raised her sword to block it. Cui Ying took the opportunity to jump up behind her and shouted: "Look at the punch!" and hit her on the left shoulder with a "Fighting Chicken Seizing Millet". Gu Huiyun flipped her left wrist and used the grappling method to deflect it. Cui Ying took advantage of the moment when she was blocking the sword with her right hand and making a fist with her left hand, and pressed her chest with a palm. This palm seemed to be a real blow, and she must be seriously injured. Gu Huiyun was shocked and couldn't take out her hands to fight, so she had to lean back to reduce the opponent's palm force.

    Unexpectedly, Cui Ying didn't use her strength. She touched Gu Huiyun's chest with her palm, touched it heavily, smiled, and jumped back. Gu Huiyun was so angry that she turned around and stabbed with her sword. When Cui Ying dodged, she struck out with another sword. She actually tried her best to resist Du Jingfang's sword and attacked Cui Ying.

    During the day, Du Jingfang saw Gu Huiyun's excellent swordsmanship, and had already paid attention. Originally, she only wanted to test her skills, and had no intention of hurting her. However, she saw that she ignored her sword moves and stopped moving when he stabbed her. At this time, Gu Huiyun's attack was fierce. Cui Ying couldn't move her hand to draw her sword, and was forced to retreat continuously. She was still angry at her: "I touched it, I touched it! It's useless even if you kill me. Hehe." Gu Huiyun made a move: "God Camel Jun's Foot" He straightened his sword and stabbed straight. When the tip of the sword was about to reach, he suddenly turned around and used the unique secret of Lingxiao Pavilion swordsmanship, "Mirage". It was virtual and real, and the sword was bright. Cui Ying was dazzled and at a loss. She was about to die under the sword.

    Du Jingfang couldn't ignore it at this time, and took over Gu Huiyun's offensive again with her sword.
title_en: Chapter 7: Driving the tiger away from the mountain
